01 / CAMERA

Find your bow position.

Point your right index with the other fingers tucked to sustain a note. Move your hand down for stronger upper harmonics, like bowing near the bridge. Move up for a soft, flute-like sound, like bowing over the fingerboard. Relax your index to stop. Left fingers still choose pitch.

02 / STRINGS

Give yourself four voices.

The strings open by default. Click a circle once for normal, twice for harmonic, and once more for off. Mix filled normal notes and translucent harmonics across strings. Stop all sound clears your selection.

03 / HARMONICS

Same pitch, new character.

Camera hand height changes upper-harmonic amplitudes while preserving the selected fundamental. When the camera is off, each mixer slider controls a harmonic at a whole-number multiple of that frequency. Pure has only the fundamental; Hollow favours odd harmonics; Electric adds stronger upper harmonics.
